row.body: The measure step filtered loop_beats by started_at with only a (loop,slot) index, so four metrics scanned every beat per tick (250k rows/h vs 120k limit) and the tick skipped selfaudit, dispatch and execute. Added loop_beats(started_at) and tick_runs(finished_at) indexes. Session: session_0156nqDsqGCaorJAUs6hPGox
